$comment: This schema reserves optional fields for the week 14 topology read-path coverage design. These fields remain optional until the runtime contracts implement them.
title: TopologyRecord

topology_id.description: Stable identifier for the backend-owned normalized topology snapshot.

topology_name.description: Human-readable topology name for the bounded product slice.

nodes.description: Normalized topology nodes owned by the backend contract.

links.description: Normalized inferred or observed topology links owned by the backend contract.

endpoint_pairing_state.description: Planned optional week 14 field describing how much endpoint evidence backs one emitted normalized link.

endpoint_evidence_count.description: Planned optional week 14 field giving the count of observed endpoints contributing to one emitted normalized link.

coverage_summary.description: Planned optional week 14 aggregate coverage summary for endpoint-pairing posture inside the bounded inferred topology slice.

endpoint_pairing_posture.description: Planned optional week 14 aggregate pairing posture for emitted normalized links only.

paired_link_count.description: Planned optional week 14 count of emitted normalized links backed by both observed endpoints.

single_sided_link_count.description: Planned optional week 14 count of emitted normalized links backed by only one observed endpoint.
